title: 0078 프로젝트 보류 · 프로젝트 일지 · 받은 일 읽음 — 보류 상태와 다시 볼 날(보류일 때만), 일지는 서버만(추가만 · 같은 업체 프로젝트만), 읽음은 서버만(본 때는 앞으로만)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{customer_x}}, {{company_x}}, 'probe'), ({{customer_y}}, {{company_y}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title) VALUES ({{project_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, 'probe X'), ({{project_y}}, {{company_y}}, {{customer_y}}, 'probe Y')
UPDATE public.projects SET status = 'on_hold', hold_until = '2026-12-05', status_note = 'probe', status_at = now(), status_by = {{x_owner_user}} WHERE id = {{project_x}}

INSERT INTO public.project_events (id, company_id, project_id, actor_user_id, actor_kind, type, subject_type, subject_id, from_status, to_status) VALUES ({{ev_a}}, {{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'member', 'status_changed', 'project', {{project_x}}::text, 'active', 'on_hold')
INSERT INTO public.inbox_seen (user_id, company_id, seen_at) VALUES ({{x_owner_user}}, {{company_x}}, '2026-11-20T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE public.inbox_seen SET seen_at = '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' WHERE user_id = {{x_owner_user}} AND company_id = {{company_x}}

checks.name: 보류 — 상태와 다시 볼 날이 적혔다 (그 업체 구성원만 읽는다 · 남의 업체 0 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.projects where id = {{project_x}} and status = 'on_hold' and hold_until = '2026-12-05' and status_by = {{x_owner_user}} and status_at is not null

checks.name: 다시 볼 날은 보류일 때만
checks.sql: update public.projects set hold_until = '2026-12-01' where id = {{project_y}}

checks.name: 모르는 상태는 못 넣는다
checks.sql: update public.projects set status = 'paused' where id = {{project_y}}

checks.name: 상태 메모는 200자까지
checks.sql: update public.projects set status_note = repeat('가', 201) where id = {{project_y}}

checks.name: 일지 읽기 — 서버만 (구성원 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.project_events where project_id = {{project_x}}

checks.name: 일지 쓰기 — 서버가 한 줄 더한다 (고객이 한 일 · 초안 id 는 글자)
checks.sql: insert into public.project_events (company_id, project_id, actor_kind, type, subject_type, subject_id, payload) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'customer', 'quote_approved', 'draft', 'pr-req-1', '{"view_count": 2}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 구성원은 일지를 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.project_events (company_id, project_id, actor_kind, type) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'member', 'probe')

checks.name: 행동한 쪽은 다섯 가지만
checks.sql: insert into public.project_events (company_id, project_id, actor_kind, type) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'robot', 'probe')

checks.name: payload 는 2000바이트까지
checks.sql: insert into public.project_events (company_id, project_id, actor_kind, type, payload) values ({{company_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'system', 'probe', jsonb_build_object('x', repeat('a', 2100)))

checks.name: 같은 업체 프로젝트에만 (남의 업체 id 로는 거절)
checks.sql: insert into public.project_events (company_id, project_id, actor_kind, type) values ({{company_y}}, {{project_x}}, 'system', 'probe')

checks.name: 일지 고치기는 서버도 못 한다
checks.sql: update public.project_events set type = 'changed' where id = {{ev_a}}

checks.name: 읽음 읽기 — 서버만 (본인도 직접은 못 읽는다)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.inbox_seen where user_id = {{x_owner_user}}

checks.name: 본 때는 뒤로 가지 않는다 (준비 단계에서 11-01 로 되돌리려 했다)
checks.sql: select to_char(seen_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') from public.inbox_seen where user_id = {{x_owner_user}} and company_id = {{company_x}}

checks.name: 본 때는 앞으로는 간다
checks.sql: update public.inbox_seen set seen_at = '2026-11-21T00:00:00Z' where user_id = {{x_owner_user}} and company_id = {{company_x}}

checks.name: 한 사람 · 한 업체에 한 줄
checks.sql: insert into public.inbox_seen (user_id, company_id, seen_at) values ({{x_owner_user}}, {{company_x}}, now())
